editorial:
Imagine feeling stuck in a rut with the person you love most. You'll meet Marshall, a stressed-out ad executive who is hitting a wall in his seven-year relationship. Just as he is turning thirty, he feels a desperate need for a spark in his life. That is when he finds eCupid, a weird and mysterious dating app. Suddenly, his quiet life becomes a whirlwind of hot guys and unexpected romantic encounters. It feels like a modern fairy tale with a digital twist, mixing a bit of fantasy with the everyday struggles of keeping a long-term relationship alive.

You will likely enjoy the fast pace and the funny way the app disrupts Marshall's routine. The acting is natural and makes you root for him to figure things out. While the plot is pretty simple, it is a lighthearted ride that does not take itself too seriously.
endingExplained: After all the chaos and meeting countless attractive men, Marshall realizes that the thrill of the app was just a distraction from his real problems. He learns that the grass isn't always greener on the other side. He decides to put the app away and commit to his loving boyfriend. They talk through their issues and choose to fix their relationship, proving that real love is better than a digital fantasy.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky romantic comedies and stories about second chances.
